1→// hooks_claudecode_handlers.go contains Claude Code specific hook handler implementations.
     2→// These are called by the hook registry in hook_registry.go.
     3→package cli
     4→
     5→import (
     6→	"context"
     7→	"encoding/json"
     8→	"fmt"
     9→	"log/slog"
    10→	"os"
    11→	"path/filepath"
    12→	"strings"
    13→	"time"
    14→
    15→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent"
    16→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode"
    17→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/logging"
    18→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
    19→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/session"
    20→	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy"
    21→)
    22→
    23→// hookInputData contains parsed hook input and session identifiers.
    24→type hookInputData struct {
    25→	agent     agent.Agent
    26→	input     *agent.HookInput
    27→	sessionID string
    28→}
    29→
    30→// parseAndLogHookInput parses the hook input and sets up logging context.
    31→func parseAndLogHookInput() (*hookInputData, error) {
    32→	// Get the agent from the hook command context (e.g., "entire hooks claude-code ...")
    33→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
    34→	if err != nil {
    35→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
    36→	}
    37→
    38→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
    39→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookUserPromptSubmit, os.Stdin)
    40→	if err != nil {
    41→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
    42→	}
    43→
    44→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
    45→	logging.Info(logCtx, "user-prompt-submit",
    46→		slog.String("hook", "user-prompt-submit"),
    47→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
    48→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
    49→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
    50→	)
    51→
    52→	sessionID := input.SessionID
    53→	if sessionID == "" {
    54→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
    55→	}
    56→
    57→	// Get the Entire session ID, preferring the persisted value to handle midnight boundary
    58→	return &hookInputData{
    59→		agent:     ag,
    60→		input:     input,
    61→		sessionID: sessionID,
    62→	}, nil
    63→}
    64→
    65→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.
    66→func captureInitialState() error {
    67→	// Parse hook input and setup logging
    68→	hookData, err := parseAndLogHookInput()
    69→	if err != nil {
    70→		return err
    71→	}
    72→
    73→	// CLI captures state directly (including transcript position)
    74→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(hookData.sessionID, hookData.input.SessionRef); err != nil {
    75→		return err
    76→	}
    77→
    78→	// If strategy implements SessionInitializer, call it to initialize session state
    79→	strat := GetStrategy()
    80→
    81→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (git hooks, gitignore, metadata branch).
    82→	// Done here at turn start so hooks are installed before any mid-turn commits.
    83→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
    84→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
    85→	}
    86→
    87→	if initializer, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionInitializer); ok {
    88→		agentType := hookData.agent.Type()
    89→		if err := initializer.InitializeSession(hookData.sessionID, agentType, hookData.input.SessionRef, hookData.input.UserPrompt); err != nil {
    90→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to initialize session state: %v\n", err)
    91→		}
    92→	}
    93→
    94→	return nil
    95→}
    96→
    97→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
    98→func commitWithMetadata() error { //nolint:maintidx // already present in codebase
    99→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
   100→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   101→	if err != nil {
   102→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   103→	}
   104→
   105→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   106→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   107→	if err != nil {
   108→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   109→	}
   110→
   111→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   112→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   113→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   114→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   115→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   116→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   117→	)
   118→
   119→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   120→	if sessionID == "" {
   121→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   122→	}
   123→
   124→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   125→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   126→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   127→	}
   128→
   129→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   130→	// Without this, the function does a lot of work (transcript copy, prompt extraction, etc.)
   131→	// before eventually failing deep in strategy.SaveChanges().
   132→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   133→		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping checkpoint. Will activate after first commit.")
   134→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   138→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   139→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   140→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   141→	if err != nil {
   142→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   143→	}
   144→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   145→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   146→	}
   147→
   148→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   149→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   150→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   151→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   152→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   153→
   154→	// Copy transcript
   155→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   156→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   157→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   158→	}
   159→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   160→
   161→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   162→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   163→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   164→	if err != nil {
   165→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   166→	}
   167→
   168→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   169→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   170→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   171→	var transcriptOffset int
   172→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   173→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   174→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   175→	} else {
   176→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   177→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   178→		if loadErr != nil {
   179→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   180→		}
   181→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   182→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   183→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   184→		}
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   188→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   189→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   190→	var totalLines int
   191→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   192→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   193→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   194→		if err != nil {
   195→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   196→		}
   197→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   198→	} else {
   199→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   200→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   201→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   202→		if err != nil {
   203→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   204→		}
   205→	}
   206→
   207→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   208→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   209→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   210→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   211→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   212→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   213→	}
   214→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   215→
   216→	// Extract summary
   217→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   218→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   219→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   220→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   221→	}
   222→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   223→
   224→	// Get modified files from transcript
   225→	modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   226→
   227→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   228→	lastPrompt := ""
   229→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   230→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   231→	}
   232→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   233→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   234→
   235→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   236→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   237→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   238→	if err != nil {
   239→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   240→	}
   241→
   242→	if preState != nil {
   243→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   244→	}
   245→
   246→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   247→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   248→	if err != nil {
   249→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   250→	}
   251→
   252→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   253→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   254→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   255→	if changes != nil {
   256→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   257→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   258→	}
   259→
   260→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   261→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   262→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   263→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   264→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   265→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   266→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   267→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   268→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   269→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   270→		}
   271→		return nil
   272→	}
   273→
   274→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   275→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   276→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   277→	}
   278→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   279→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   280→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   281→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   282→		}
   283→	}
   284→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   285→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   286→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   287→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   288→		}
   289→	}
   290→
   291→	// Create context file before saving changes
   292→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   293→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   294→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   295→	}
   296→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   297→
   298→	// Get git author from local/global config
   299→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   300→	if err != nil {
   301→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   302→	}
   303→
   304→	// Get the configured strategy
   305→	strat := GetStrategy()
   306→
   307→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   308→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   309→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   310→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   311→	}
   312→
   313→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   314→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   315→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   316→	if preState != nil {
   317→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   318→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   319→	}
   320→
   321→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   322→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   323→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   324→		// Subagents are stored in a subagents/ directory next to the main transcript
   325→		subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), sessionID, "subagents")
   326→		usage, err := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   327→		if err != nil {
   328→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", err)
   329→		} else {
   330→			tokenUsage = usage
   331→		}
   332→	}
   333→
   334→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   335→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   336→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   337→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   338→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   339→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   340→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   341→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   342→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   343→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   344→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   345→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   346→		AgentType:                agentType,
   347→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   348→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   349→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   350→	}
   351→
   352→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   353→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   354→	}
   355→
   356→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   357→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   358→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   359→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   360→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   361→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   362→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   363→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   364→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   365→		if loadErr != nil {
   366→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   367→		}
   368→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   369→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   370→		if sessionState == nil {
   371→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   372→				SessionID: sessionID,
   373→			}
   374→		}
   375→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   376→		sessionState.StepCount++
   377→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   378→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   379→		} else {
   380→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   381→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   382→		}
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   386→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   387→	// For ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE, HandleTurnEnd dispatches ActionCondense.
   388→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   389→
   390→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   391→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   392→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   393→	}
   394→
   395→	return nil
   396→}

   398→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   399→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   400→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   401→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   402→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   403→	if err != nil {
   404→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   405→	}
   406→
   407→	// Get agent for logging context
   408→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   409→	if err != nil {
   410→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   411→	}
   412→
   413→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   414→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   415→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   416→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   417→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   418→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   419→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   420→	)
   421→
   422→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   423→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   424→	if !found {
   425→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   426→		return nil
   427→	}
   428→
   429→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   430→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   431→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   432→		return nil
   433→	}
   434→
   435→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   436→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   437→	if err != nil {
   438→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   439→		return nil
   440→	}
   441→
   442→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   443→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   444→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   445→		return nil
   446→	}
   447→
   448→	// Get git author
   449→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   450→	if err != nil {
   451→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   452→		return nil
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	// Get the active strategy
   456→	strat := GetStrategy()
   457→
   458→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   459→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   460→	if sessionID == "" {
   461→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   462→	}
   463→
   464→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   465→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   466→
   467→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   468→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   469→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   470→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   471→	if todoContent == "" {
   472→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   473→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   474→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   475→		if todoCount > 0 {
   476→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   477→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   478→		}
   479→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   480→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   481→	}
   482→
   483→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   484→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   485→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   486→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   487→	}
   488→
   489→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   490→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   491→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   492→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   493→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   494→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   495→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   496→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   497→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   498→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   499→		IsIncremental:       true,
   500→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   501→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   502→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   503→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   504→		AgentType:           agentType,
   505→	}
   506→
   507→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   508→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   509→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   510→		return nil
   511→	}
   512→
   513→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   514→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   515→	return nil
   516→}

   554→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   555→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   556→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   557→	if err != nil {
   558→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   559→	}
   560→
   561→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   562→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   563→
   564→	// Get agent for logging context
   565→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   566→	if err != nil {
   567→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   568→	}
   569→
   570→	// Log parsed input context
   571→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   572→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   573→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   574→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   575→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   576→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   577→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   578→	)
   579→
   580→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   581→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   582→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   583→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   584→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   585→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   586→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   587→		}
   588→	}
   589→
   590→	// Log context to stdout
   591→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   592→
   593→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   594→	var modifiedFiles []string
   595→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   596→		// Use subagent transcript if available
   597→		transcript, err := parseTranscript(subagentTranscriptPath)
   598→		if err != nil {
   599→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse subagent transcript: %v\n", err)
   600→		} else {
   601→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   602→		}
   603→	} else {
   604→		// Fall back to main transcript
   605→		transcript, err := parseTranscript(input.TranscriptPath)
   606→		if err != nil {
   607→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse transcript: %v\n", err)
   608→		} else {
   609→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   610→		}
   611→	}
   612→
   613→	// Load pre-task state and compute new files
   614→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID)
   615→	if err != nil {
   616→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-task state: %v\n", err)
   617→	}
   618→
   619→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   620→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   621→	if err != nil {
   622→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   623→	}
   624→
   625→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   626→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   627→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   628→	if err != nil {
   629→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   630→	}
   631→
   632→	// Filter and normalize paths
   633→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   634→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   635→	if changes != nil {
   636→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   637→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   638→	}
   639→
   640→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   641→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   642→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint\n")
   643→		// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   644→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   645→		return nil
   646→	}
   647→
   648→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort, ignore errors)
   649→	transcript, _ := parseTranscript(input.TranscriptPath) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort extraction
   650→	checkpointUUID, _ := FindCheckpointUUID(transcript, input.ToolUseID)
   651→
   652→	// Get git author
   653→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   654→	if err != nil {
   655→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   656→	}
   657→
   658→	// Get the configured strategy
   659→	strat := GetStrategy()
   660→
   661→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   662→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   663→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   664→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   665→	}
   666→
   667→	// Build task checkpoint context - strategy handles metadata creation
   668→	// Note: Incremental checkpoints are now created during task execution via handleClaudeCodePostTodo,
   669→	// so we don't need to collect/cleanup staging area here.
   670→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   671→		SessionID:              input.SessionID,
   672→		ToolUseID:              input.ToolUseID,
   673→		AgentID:                input.AgentID,
   674→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   675→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   676→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   677→		TranscriptPath:         input.TranscriptPath,
   678→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   679→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   680→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   681→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   682→		SubagentType:           subagentType,
   683→		TaskDescription:        taskDescription,
   684→		AgentType:              agentType,
   685→	}
   686→
   687→	// Call strategy to save task checkpoint - strategy handles all metadata creation
   688→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   689→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task checkpoint: %w", err)
   690→	}
   691→
   692→	// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   693→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   694→
   695→	return nil
   696→}

   722→	)
   723→
   724→	if input.SessionID == "" {

   726→	}

   729→	if err := markSessionEnded(input.SessionID); err != nil {

   735→// transitionSessionTurnEnd fires EventTurnEnd to move the session from
   736→// ACTIVE → IDLE (or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE). Best-effort: logs warnings
   737→// on failure rather than returning errors.
   738→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID string) {
   739→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   740→	if loadErr != nil {
   741→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state for turn end: %v\n", loadErr)
   742→		return
   743→	}
   744→	if turnState == nil {
   745→		return
   746→	}
   747→	remaining := strategy.TransitionAndLog(turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{})
   748→
   749→	// Dispatch strategy-specific actions (e.g., ActionCondense for ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE)
   750→	if len(remaining) > 0 {
   751→		strat := GetStrategy()
   752→		if handler, ok := strat.(strategy.TurnEndHandler); ok {
   753→			if err := handler.HandleTurnEnd(turnState, remaining); err != nil {
   754→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end action dispatch failed: %v\n", err)
   755→			}
   756→		}
   757→	}
   758→
   759→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(turnState); updateErr != nil {
   760→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session phase on turn end: %v\n", updateErr)
   761→	}
   762→}
   763→
   764→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   765→func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
   766→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   767→	if err != nil {
   768→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   769→	}
   770→	if state == nil {
   771→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   772→	}
   773→
   774→	strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{})
   775→
   776→	now := time.Now()
   777→	state.EndedAt = &now
   778→
   779→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   780→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   781→	}
   782→	return nil
   783→}
   784→
   785→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   786→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   787→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   788→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   789→
   790→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   791→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   792→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   793→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   794→//
   795→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   796→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   797→//
   798→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   799→// with whatever data is available.
   800→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   801→	const (
   802→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   803→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   804→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   805→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   806→	)
   807→
   808→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   809→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   810→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   811→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   812→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   813→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   814→			)
   815→			return
   816→		}
   817→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   818→	}
   819→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   820→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   821→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   822→	)
   823→}

   826→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   827→// close to hookStartTime.
   828→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   829→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   830→	if err != nil {
   831→		return false
   832→	}
   833→	defer f.Close()
   834→
   835→	// Seek to tail
   836→	info, err := f.Stat()
   837→	if err != nil {
   838→		return false
   839→	}
   840→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   841→	if offset < 0 {

   843→	}

   847→	}

   855→		}

   857→		// Parse timestamp to check recency

You are implementing Task 2: Update `commitWithMetadata` Stop hook to Include Subagent Files

## Task Description

**File to modify:** `cmd/entire/cli/hooks_claudecode_handlers.go`

The `commitWithMetadata()` function (line 98) is the Stop hook. At line 225, it extracts modified files from only the main transcript:

```go
// Get modified files from transcript
modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
```

This misses all subagent file modifications. We need to replace this with a call to `claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles` which includes subagent transcripts.

**The change:**

1. At line 225, replace the single `extractModifiedFiles(transcript)` call with `claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles`. The subagent directory path follows the Claude Code layout: `<transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/`. Use `input.SessionID` (the model's raw session ID) for path construction, NOT the `sessionID` variable (which may have been overridden to `unknownSessionID`).

2. Add a fallback: if `ExtractAllModifiedFiles` fails, fall back to the original `extractModifiedFiles(transcript)`.

3. At line ~325, there's already a `subagentsDir` variable defined for token usage. Since we now define `subagentsDir` earlier (for file extraction), we need to reuse it rather than redefine it. Change line 325 from `subagentsDir := ...` to just reuse the variable.

**Concrete code change at line 225:**

```go
// REPLACE THIS (line 225):
modifiedFiles := extractModifiedFiles(transcript)

// WITH THIS:
// Get modified files from transcript (main agent + subagents).
// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), input.SessionID, "subagents")
modifiedFiles, subagentErr := claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir)
if subagentErr != nil {
    fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to extract modified files with subagents: %v\n", subagentErr)
    // Fall back to main transcript only
    modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
}
```

**And at line ~325 (token usage section):**

```go
// REPLACE THIS (line ~325):
```
```go
subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), sessionID, "subagents")
```

```go
usage, tokenErr := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
```

```go
	}
```

```go
"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/claudecode"
```

```go
// ExtractAllModifiedFiles extracts files modified by both the main agent and any
// subagents spawned via the Task tool. It follows the same pattern as
// CalculateTotalTokenUsage: parse main transcript, extract spawned agent IDs,
// then read each subagent transcript.
//
// Parameters:
//   - transcriptPath: path to the main agent's JSONL transcript
//   - startLine: line offset to start parsing from (0 = beginning)
//   - subagentsDir: directory containing subagent transcripts (agent-<id>.jsonl)
//
// Returns deduplicated list of file paths modified by any agent.
func ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptPath string, startLine int, subagentsDir string) ([]string, error) {
	if transcriptPath == "" {
		return nil, nil
	}

	// Parse main transcript
	transcript, err := parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, startLine)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
	}

	// Extract files from main agent
	fileSet := make(map[string]bool)
	var files []string
	for _, f := range ExtractModifiedFiles(transcript) {
		if !fileSet[f] {
			fileSet[f] = true
			files = append(files, f)
		}
	}

	// Extract spawned agent IDs and scan their transcripts
	agentIDs := ExtractSpawnedAgentIDs(transcript)
	for agentID := range agentIDs {
		agentPath := filepath.Join(subagentsDir, fmt.Sprintf("agent-%s.jsonl", agentID))
		agentTranscript, readErr := parseTranscriptFromLine(agentPath, 0)
		if readErr != nil {
			continue // Subagent transcript may not exist or may have been cleaned up
		}
		for _, f := range ExtractModifiedFiles(agentTranscript) {
			if !fileSet[f] {
				fileSet[f] = true
				files = append(files, f)
			}
		}
	}

	return files, nil
}
```

   606→// CreateGeminiTranscript creates a Gemini JSON transcript file for the session.
   607→func (s *GeminiSession) CreateGeminiTranscript(prompt string, changes []FileChange) string {
   608→	// Build Gemini-format transcript (JSON, not JSONL)
   609→	messages := []map[string]interface{}{
   610→		{
   611→			"type":    "user",
   612→			"content": prompt,
   613→		},
   614→		{
   615→			"type":    "assistant",
   616→			"content": "I'll help you with that.",
   617→		},
   618→	}
   619→
   620→	for _, change := range changes {
   621→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   622→			"type": "tool_use",
   623→			"name": "write_file",
   624→			"input": map[string]string{
   625→				"path":    change.Path,
   626→				"content": change.Content,
   627→			},
   628→		})
   629→		messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   630→			"type":   "tool_result",
   631→			"output": "File written successfully",
   632→		})
   633→	}
   634→
   635→	messages = append(messages, map[string]interface{}{
   636→		"type":    "assistant",
   637→		"content": "Done!",
   638→	})
   639→
   640→	transcript := map[string]interface{}{
   641→		"sessionId": s.ID,
   642→		"messages":  messages,
   643→	}
   644→
   645→	// Ensure directory exists
   646→	if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(s.TranscriptPath), 0o755); err != nil {
   647→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to create transcript dir: %v", err)
   648→	}
   649→
   650→	// Write transcript
   651→	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(transcript, "", "  ")
   652→	if err != nil {
   653→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to marshal transcript: %v", err)
   654→	}
   655→	if err := os.WriteFile(s.TranscriptPath, data, 0o644); err != nil {
   656→		s.env.T.Fatalf("failed to write transcript: %v", err)
   657→	}
   658→
   659→	return s.TranscriptPath
   660→}

    20→// TestSubagentCheckpoints_FullFlow tests the complete subagent checkpoint flow:
    21→// PreTask -> PostTodo (multiple times with file changes) -> PostTask
    22→//
    23→// This verifies:
    24→// 1. Incremental checkpoints are created as commits during subagent execution
    25→// 2. Only PostTodo calls with file changes create commits
    26→// 3. PostTask creates the final task checkpoint commit
    27→func TestSubagentCheckpoints_FullFlow(t *testing.T) {
    28→	t.Parallel()
    29→	RunForAllStrategies(t, func(t *testing.T, env *TestEnv, strategyName string) {
    30→		// Create a session
    31→		session := env.NewSession()
    32→
    33→		// Create transcript (needed by hooks)
    34→		session.CreateTranscript("Implement feature X", []FileChange{
    35→			{Path: "feature.go", Content: "package main"},
    36→		})
    37→
    38→		// Simulate user prompt submit first (captures pre-prompt state)
    39→		err := env.SimulateUserPromptSubmit(session.ID)
    40→		if err != nil {
    41→			t.Fatalf("SimulateUserPromptSubmit failed: %v", err)
    42→		}
    43→
    44→		// Task tool use ID (simulates Claude's Task tool invocation)
    45→		taskToolUseID := "toolu_01TaskABC123"
    46→
    47→		// Step 1: PreTask - creates pre-task file
    48→		err = env.SimulatePreTask(session.ID, session.TranscriptPath, taskToolUseID)
    49→		if err != nil {
    50→			t.Fatalf("SimulatePreTask failed: %v", err)
    51→		}
    52→
    53→		// Verify pre-task file was created
    54→		preTaskFile := filepath.Join(env.RepoDir, ".entire", "tmp", "pre-task-"+taskToolUseID+".json")
    55→		if _, err := os.Stat(preTaskFile); os.IsNotExist(err) {
    56→			t.Error("pre-task file should exist after SimulatePreTask")
    57→		}
    58→
    59→		// Step 2: PostTodo - simulate TodoWrite calls with file changes between them
    60→		// Note: Only PostTodo calls that detect file changes will create incremental commits
    61→
    62→		// First TodoWrite - no file changes, should be skipped
    63→		err = env.SimulatePostTodo(PostTodoInput{
    64→			SessionID:      session.ID,
    65→			TranscriptPath: session.TranscriptPath,
    66→			ToolUseID:      "toolu_01TodoWrite001",
    67→			Todos: []Todo{
    68→				{Content: "Create feature file", Status: "in_progress", ActiveForm: "Creating feature file"},
    69→				{Content: "Write tests", Status: "pending", ActiveForm: "Writing tests"},
    70→			},
    71→		})
    72→		if err != nil {
    73→			t.Fatalf("SimulatePostTodo failed for first todo: %v", err)
    74→		}
    75→
    76→		// Create a file change
    77→		env.WriteFile("feature.go", "package main\n\nfunc Feature() {}\n")
    78→
    79→		// Second TodoWrite - should create incremental checkpoint (has file changes)
    80→		err = env.SimulatePostTodo(PostTodoInput{
    81→			SessionID:      session.ID,
    82→			TranscriptPath: session.TranscriptPath,
    83→			ToolUseID:      "toolu_01TodoWrite002",
    84→			Todos: []Todo{
    85→				{Content: "Create feature file", Status: "completed", ActiveForm: "Creating feature file"},
    86→				{Content: "Write tests", Status: "in_progress", ActiveForm: "Writing tests"},
    87→			},
    88→		})
    89→		if err != nil {
    90→			t.Fatalf("SimulatePostTodo failed for second todo: %v", err)
    91→		}
    92→
    93→		// Create another file change
    94→		env.WriteFile("feature_test.go", "package main\n\nimport \"testing\"\n\nfunc TestFeature(t *testing.T) {}\n")
    95→
    96→		// Third TodoWrite - should create another incremental checkpoint
    97→		err = env.SimulatePostTodo(PostTodoInput{
    98→			SessionID:      session.ID,
    99→			TranscriptPath: session.TranscriptPath,
   100→			ToolUseID:      "toolu_01TodoWrite003",
   101→			Todos: []Todo{
   102→				{Content: "Create feature file", Status: "completed", ActiveForm: "Creating feature file"},
   103→				{Content: "Write tests", Status: "completed", ActiveForm: "Writing tests"},
   104→			},
   105→		})
   106→		if err != nil {
   107→			t.Fatalf("SimulatePostTodo failed for third todo: %v", err)
   108→		}
   109→
   110→		// Step 3: PostTask - creates final task checkpoint
   111→		err = env.SimulatePostTask(PostTaskInput{
   112→			SessionID:      session.ID,
   113→			TranscriptPath: session.TranscriptPath,
   114→			ToolUseID:      taskToolUseID,
   115→			AgentID:        "agent-123",
   116→		})
   117→		if err != nil {
   118→			t.Fatalf("SimulatePostTask failed: %v", err)
   119→		}
   120→
   121→		// Verify pre-task file is cleaned up
   122→		if _, err := os.Stat(preTaskFile); !os.IsNotExist(err) {
   123→			t.Error("Pre-task file should be removed after PostTask")
   124→		}
   125→
   126→		// Verify checkpoints are stored in final location (strategy-specific)
   127→		verifyCheckpointStorage(t, env, strategyName, session.ID, taskToolUseID)
   128→	})
   129→}

   135→		// Create a session

   155→		beforeCommits := env.GetGitLog()

   157→		// Call PostTodo WITHOUT making any file changes

## Task: Write Integration Test for Subagent-Only File Modification Checkpoint

### Context

We fixed a bug (ENT-297) where subagent file modifications were invisible to checkpoint detection. When only subagents (spawned via the Task tool) modified files, checkpoints were skipped because `totalChanges = 0`. We've already fixed the code in three prior commits. Now we need an integration test proving the fix works end-to-end.

### What You Need to Know

**The bug:** The Stop hook in `hooks_claudecode_handlers.go` extracts modified files from the transcript to decide whether to create a checkpoint. Previously, it only looked at the main agent's transcript. When subagents (spawned via the Task tool) performed all file modifications, those tool calls lived in separate `agent-<id>.jsonl` files and were invisible, causing `totalChanges = 0` and the checkpoint to be skipped.

**The fix:** We added `ExtractAllModifiedFiles()` which also reads subagent transcript files. The Stop hook now uses this function.

**Subagent transcript layout:**
- Main transcript: `<some-path>/transcript.jsonl`  
- Subagent transcripts: `<some-path>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`

### Your Task

Write an integration test in `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go` that:

1. Creates a session and calls SimulateUserPromptSubmit
2. Creates a file on disk (simulating what a subagent would write)
3. Creates a main transcript that only has a Task tool call (NO Write/Edit calls)
4. Creates a subagent transcript file (in the correct directory structure) that has Write tool calls referencing the created file
5. Calls SimulateStop with the transcript path
6. Verifies the stop hook does NOT error
7. For auto-commit strategy: verifies a checkpoint was created (new commit on active branch)
8. For manual-commit strategy: verifies the shadow branch has checkpoint data

### Key Integration Test Patterns

The test should follow the pattern from `TestHookRunner_SimulateStop` in `hooks_test.go`:

```go
func TestHookRunner_SimulateStop_SubagentOnlyChanges(t *testing.T) {
    t.Parallel()
    RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv(t, func(t *testing.T, env *TestEnv, strategyName string) {
        // ... test body
    })
}
```

**Important:** The test MUST use `RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv` (not feature branch) since stop hook tests work on any branch.

### Transcript Format

The `TranscriptBuilder` in `integration_test/transcript.go` has methods:
- `AddTaskToolUse(toolUseID, prompt)` - adds a Task tool invocation
- `AddTaskToolResult(toolUseID, agentID)` - adds a Task tool result with agent ID
- `AddToolUse(toolName, filePath, content)` - adds a Write/Edit tool use
- `AddToolResult(toolUseID)` - adds a tool result
- `WriteToFile(path)` - writes the transcript JSONL

The subagent transcript files need to be in the Claude Code format. They are separate JSONL files that follow the same format as the main transcript. The important thing is the path: `<transcriptDir>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`.

The `input.SessionID` in the Stop hook is the model session ID, which is `session.ID` in the test framework.

### How SimulateStop Works

When `SimulateStop` is called, it runs `entire hooks claude-code stop` with the session ID and transcript path as JSON input. The Stop hook:
1. Reads the transcript
2. Calls `ExtractAllModifiedFiles` (our fix!) to get modified files from main + subagent transcripts
3. Detects file changes on disk (via `git status`)
4. If `totalChanges > 0`, creates a checkpoint

The `ClaudeProjectDir` in the test env is used for agent session data. The transcript path can be anywhere (the test framework puts it in `.entire/tmp/`).

### Subagent Transcript File Format

A subagent transcript is just a JSONL file with the same message format. For the test, you can use a separate `TranscriptBuilder` to create it. The subagent transcript should have Write tool calls with `file_path` pointing to the actual file path in the test repo.

Example subagent transcript entry (JSONL line):
```json
{"uuid":"asst-1","type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/absolute/path/to/file.go","content":"package main"}}]},"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
```

Note the tool name should be `Write` (or `mcp__acp__Write` which the existing code also handles) - check what `extractModifiedFiles` actually looks for.

### What extractModifiedFiles Looks For

The `ExtractModifiedFiles` function in `transcript.go` looks for tool_use blocks with names:
- `Write` 
- `Edit`
- `NotebookEdit`
- `mcp__acp__Write`
- `mcp__acp__Edit`

It extracts the `file_path` from the `input` field.

### Verification

**For auto-commit strategy:** A new commit should be created on the active branch. Check with `env.GetGitLog()` comparing before/after commit count, or check HEAD commit message.

**For manual-commit strategy:** A checkpoint should be stored on the shadow branch. Check `env.BranchExists(env.GetShadowBranchName())` to verify the shadow branch was created, and/or check the session state.

**For both strategies:** The SimulateStop call should NOT return an error.

### File Location

Add the test to: `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go`

### Build Tag

The file already has `//go:build integration` at the top.

### Running Tests

```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && go test -tags integration ./cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/ -run TestHookRunner_SimulateStop_SubagentOnlyChanges -v -count=1
```

Then verify full integration test suite passes:
```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && mise run test:integration
```

And then lint:
```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && mise run fmt && mise run lint
```

### Commit

After tests pass:
```bash
git add cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go
git commit -m "test: add integration test for subagent-only checkpoint creation (ENT-297)"
```

Use the HEREDOC format for the commit message.

   660→}

## Task: Write Integration Test for Subagent-Only File Modification Checkpoint

### Context

We fixed a bug (ENT-297) where subagent file modifications were invisible to checkpoint detection. When only subagents (spawned via the Task tool) modified files, checkpoints were skipped because `totalChanges = 0`. We've already fixed the code in three prior commits. Now we need an integration test proving the fix works end-to-end.

### What You Need to Know

**The bug:** The Stop hook in `hooks_claudecode_handlers.go` extracts modified files from the transcript to decide whether to create a checkpoint. Previously, it only looked at the main agent's transcript. When subagents (spawned via the Task tool) performed all file modifications, those tool calls lived in separate `agent-<id>.jsonl` files and were invisible, causing `totalChanges = 0` and the checkpoint to be skipped.

**The fix:** We added `ExtractAllModifiedFiles()` which also reads subagent transcript files. The Stop hook now uses this function.

**Subagent transcript layout:**
- Main transcript: `<some-path>/transcript.jsonl`  
- Subagent transcripts: `<some-path>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`

### Your Task

Write an integration test in `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go` that:

1. Creates a session and calls SimulateUserPromptSubmit
2. Creates a file on disk (simulating what a subagent would write)
3. Creates a main transcript that only has a Task tool call (NO Write/Edit calls)
4. Creates a subagent transcript file (in the correct directory structure) that has Write tool calls referencing the created file
5. Calls SimulateStop with the transcript path
6. Verifies the stop hook does NOT error
7. For auto-commit strategy: verifies a checkpoint was created (new commit on active branch)
8. For manual-commit strategy: verifies the shadow branch has checkpoint data

### Key Integration Test Patterns

The test should follow the pattern from `TestHookRunner_SimulateStop` in `hooks_test.go`:

```go
func TestHookRunner_SimulateStop_SubagentOnlyChanges(t *testing.T) {
    t.Parallel()
    RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv(t, func(t *testing.T, env *TestEnv, strategyName string) {
        // ... test body
    })
}
```

**Important:** The test MUST use `RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv` (not feature branch) since stop hook tests work on any branch.

### Transcript Format

The `TranscriptBuilder` in `integration_test/transcript.go` has methods:
- `AddTaskToolUse(toolUseID, prompt)` - adds a Task tool invocation
- `AddTaskToolResult(toolUseID, agentID)` - adds a Task tool result with agent ID
- `AddToolUse(toolName, filePath, content)` - adds a Write/Edit tool use
- `AddToolResult(toolUseID)` - adds a tool result
- `WriteToFile(path)` - writes the transcript JSONL

The subagent transcript files need to be in the Claude Code format. They are separate JSONL files that follow the same format as the main transcript. The important thing is the path: `<transcriptDir>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`.

The `input.SessionID` in the Stop hook is the model session ID, which is `session.ID` in the test framework.

### How SimulateStop Works

When `SimulateStop` is called, it runs `entire hooks claude-code stop` with the session ID and transcript path as JSON input. The Stop hook:
1. Reads the transcript
2. Calls `ExtractAllModifiedFiles` (our fix!) to get modified files from main + subagent transcripts
3. Detects file changes on disk (via `git status`)
4. If `totalChanges > 0`, creates a checkpoint

The `ClaudeProjectDir` in the test env is used for agent session data. The transcript path can be anywhere (the test framework puts it in `.entire/tmp/`).

### Subagent Transcript File Format

A subagent transcript is just a JSONL file with the same message format. For the test, you can use a separate `TranscriptBuilder` to create it. The subagent transcript should have Write tool calls with `file_path` pointing to the actual file path in the test repo.

Example subagent transcript entry (JSONL line):
```json
{"uuid":"asst-1","type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/absolute/path/to/file.go","content":"package main"}}]},"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
```

Note the tool name should be `Write` (or `mcp__acp__Write` which the existing code also handles) - check what `extractModifiedFiles` actually looks for.

### What extractModifiedFiles Looks For

The `ExtractModifiedFiles` function in `transcript.go` looks for tool_use blocks with names:
- `Write` 
- `Edit`
- `NotebookEdit`
- `mcp__acp__Write`
- `mcp__acp__Edit`

It extracts the `file_path` from the `input` field.

### Verification

**For auto-commit strategy:** A new commit should be created on the active branch. Check with `env.GetGitLog()` comparing before/after commit count, or check HEAD commit message.

**For manual-commit strategy:** A checkpoint should be stored on the shadow branch. Check `env.BranchExists(env.GetShadowBranchName())` to verify the shadow branch was created, and/or check the session state.

**For both strategies:** The SimulateStop call should NOT return an error.

### File Location

Add the test to: `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go`

### Build Tag

The file already has `//go:build integration` at the top.

### Running Tests

```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && go test -tags integration ./cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/ -run TestHookRunner_SimulateStop_SubagentOnlyChanges -v -count=1
```

Then verify full integration test suite passes:
```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && mise run test:integration
```

And then lint:
```bash
cd /Users/alex/workspace/cli/.worktrees/2 && mise run fmt && mise run lint
```

### Commit

After tests pass:
```bash
git add cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go
git commit -m "test: add integration test for subagent-only checkpoint creation (ENT-297)"
```

Use the HEREDOC format for the commit message.

6. Verifies the stop hook does NOT error
7. For auto-commit strategy: verifies a checkpoint was created (new commit on active branch)
8. For manual-commit strategy: verifies the shadow branch has checkpoint data

The test should follow the pattern from `TestHookRunner_SimulateStop` in `hooks_test.go`:


**Important:** The test MUST use `RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv` (not feature branch) since stop hook tests work on any branch.

### Transcript Format

The `TranscriptBuilder` in `integration_test/transcript.go` has methods:
- `AddTaskToolUse(toolUseID, prompt)` - adds a Task tool invocation
- `AddTaskToolResult(toolUseID, agentID)` - adds a Task tool result with agent ID
- `AddToolUse(toolName, filePath, content)` - adds a Write/Edit tool use
- `AddToolResult(toolUseID)` - adds a tool result
- `WriteToFile(path)` - writes the transcript JSONL

The subagent transcript files need to be in the Claude Code format. They are separate JSONL files that follow the same format as the main transcript. The important thing is the path: `<transcriptDir>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`.

The `input.SessionID` in the Stop hook is the model session ID, which is `session.ID` in the test framework.

### How SimulateStop Works

When `SimulateStop` is called, it runs `entire hooks claude-code stop` with the session ID and transcript path as JSON input. The Stop hook:
1. Reads the transcript
2. Calls `ExtractAllModifiedFiles` (our fix!) to get modified files from main + subagent transcripts
3. Detects file changes on disk (via `git status`)
4. If `totalChanges > 0`, creates a checkpoint

The `ClaudeProjectDir` in the test env is used for agent session data. The transcript path can be anywhere (the test framework puts it in `.entire/tmp/`).

### Subagent Transcript File Format

A subagent transcript is just a JSONL file with the same message format. For the test, you can use a separate `TranscriptBuilder` to create it. The subagent transcript should have Write tool calls with `file_path` pointing to the actual file path in the test repo.

Example subagent transcript entry (JSONL line):
```json
{"uuid":"asst-1","type":"assistant","message":{"content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_1","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/absolute/path/to/file.go","content":"package main"}}]},"timestamp":"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z"}
```

Note the tool name should be `Write` (or `mcp__acp__Write` which the existing code also handles) - check what `extractModifiedFiles` actually looks for.

### What extractModifiedFiles Looks For

The `ExtractModifiedFiles` function in `transcript.go` looks for tool_use blocks with names:
- `Write` 
- `Edit`
- `NotebookEdit`
- `mcp__acp__Write`
- `mcp__acp__Edit`

It extracts the `file_path` from the `input` field.

**For auto-commit strategy:** A new commit should be created on the active branch. Check with `env.GetGitLog()` comparing before/after commit count, or check HEAD commit message.

**For manual-commit strategy:** A checkpoint should be stored on the shadow branch. Check `env.BranchExists(env.GetShadowBranchName())` to verify the shadow branch was created, and/or check the session state.

**For both strategies:** The SimulateStop call should NOT return an error.

## Task: Write Integration Test for Subagent-Only File Modification Checkpoint

### Context

We fixed a bug (ENT-297) where subagent file modifications were invisible to checkpoint detection. When only subagents (spawned via the Task tool) modified files, checkpoints were skipped because `totalChanges = 0`. We've already fixed the code in three prior commits. Now we need an integration test proving the fix works end-to-end.

### What You Need to Know

**The bug:** The Stop hook in `hooks_claudecode_handlers.go` extracts modified files from the transcript to decide whether to create a checkpoint. Previously, it only looked at the main agent's transcript. When subagents (spawned via the Task tool) performed all file modifications, those tool calls lived in separate `agent-<id>.jsonl` files and were invisible, causing `totalChanges = 0` and the checkpoint to be skipped.

**The fix:** We added `ExtractAllModifiedFiles()` which also reads subagent transcript files. The Stop hook now uses this function.

**Subagent transcript layout:**
- Main transcript: `<some-path>/transcript.jsonl`  
- Subagent transcripts: `<some-path>/<sessionID>/subagents/agent-<agentID>.jsonl`

### Your Task

Write an integration test in `cmd/entire/cli/integration_test/hooks_test.go` that:

1. Creates a session and calls SimulateUserPromptSubmit
2. Creates a file on disk (simulating what a subagent would write)
3. Creates a main transcript that only has a Task tool call (NO Write/Edit calls)
4. Creates a subagent transcript file (in the correct directory structure) that has Write tool calls referencing the created file
5. Calls SimulateStop with the transcript path
6. Verifies the stop hook does NOT error
7. For auto-commit strategy: verifies a checkpoint was created (new commit on active branch)
8. For manual-commit strategy: verifies the shadow branch has checkpoint data

### Key Integration Test Patterns

The test should follow the pattern from `TestHookRunner_SimulateStop` in `hooks_test.go`:

```go

    RunForAllStrategiesWithRepoEnv(t, func(t *testing.T, env *TestEnv, strategyName string) {
        // ... test body
    })
```

   179→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   180→		}
   181→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   182→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   183→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   184→		}
   185→	}
   186→
   187→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   188→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   189→	var transcript []transcriptLine
   190→	var totalLines int
   191→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   192→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   193→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   194→		if err != nil {
   195→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   196→		}
   197→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcript), totalLines)
   198→	} else {
   199→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   200→		// Use parseTranscriptFromLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   201→		transcript, totalLines, err = parseTranscriptFromLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   202→		if err != nil {
   203→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   204→		}
   205→	}
   206→
   207→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   208→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcript)
   209→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   210→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   211→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   212→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   213→	}
   214→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   215→
   216→	// Extract summary
   217→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   218→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcript)
   219→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   220→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   221→	}
   222→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   223→
   224→	// Get modified files from transcript (main agent + subagents).
   225→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   226→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), input.SessionID, "subagents")
   227→	modifiedFiles, subagentErr := claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir)
   228→	if subagentErr != nil {
   229→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to extract modified files with subagents: %v\n", subagentErr)
   230→		// Fall back to main transcript only
   231→		modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcript)
   232→	}
   233→
   234→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   235→	lastPrompt := ""
   236→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   237→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   238→	}
   239→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   240→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   241→
   242→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   243→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   244→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   245→	if err != nil {
   246→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   247→	}
   248→
   249→	if preState != nil {
   250→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   251→	}
   252→
   253→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   254→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   255→	if err != nil {
   256→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   257→	}
   258→
   259→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   260→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   261→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   262→	if changes != nil {
   263→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   264→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   265→	}
   266→
   267→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   268→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   269→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   270→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   271→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   272→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   273→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   274→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   275→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   276→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   277→		}
   278→		return nil
   279→	}
   280→
   281→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   282→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   283→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   284→	}
   285→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   286→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   287→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   288→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   289→		}
   290→	}
   291→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   292→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   293→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   294→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   295→		}
   296→	}
   297→
   298→	// Create context file before saving changes
   299→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   300→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcript); err != nil {
   301→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   302→	}
   303→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   304→
   305→	// Get git author from local/global config
   306→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   307→	if err != nil {
   308→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   309→	}
   310→
   311→	// Get the configured strategy
   312→	strat := GetStrategy()
   313→
   314→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   315→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   316→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   317→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   318→	}
   319→
   320→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   321→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   322→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   323→	if preState != nil {
   324→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   325→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   326→	}
   327→
   328→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   329→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   330→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   331→		usage, tokenErr := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   332→		if tokenErr != nil {
   333→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", tokenErr)
   334→		} else {
   335→			tokenUsage = usage
   336→		}
   337→	}
   338→
   339→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   340→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   341→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   342→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   343→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   344→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   345→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   346→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   347→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   348→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   349→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   350→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   351→		AgentType:                agentType,
   352→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   353→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   354→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   355→	}
   356→
   357→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   358→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   359→	}
   360→
   361→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   362→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   363→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   364→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   365→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   366→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   367→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   368→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   369→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   370→		if loadErr != nil {
   371→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   372→		}
   373→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   374→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   375→		if sessionState == nil {
   376→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   377→				SessionID: sessionID,
   378→			}
   379→		}
   380→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   381→		sessionState.StepCount++
   382→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   383→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   384→		} else {
   385→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   386→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   387→		}
   388→	}
   389→
   390→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   391→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE or ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE.
   392→	// For ACTIVE_COMMITTED → IDLE, HandleTurnEnd dispatches ActionCondense.
   393→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   394→
   395→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   396→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   397→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   398→	}
   399→
   400→	return nil
   401→}

   403→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   404→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   405→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   406→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   407→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   408→	if err != nil {
   409→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   410→	}
   411→
   412→	// Get agent for logging context
   413→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   414→	if err != nil {
   415→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   416→	}
   417→
   418→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   419→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   420→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   421→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   422→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   423→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   424→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   425→	)
   426→
   427→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   428→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   429→	if !found {
   430→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   431→		return nil
   432→	}
   433→
   434→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   435→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   436→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   437→		return nil
   438→	}
   439→
   440→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   441→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   442→	if err != nil {
   443→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   444→		return nil
   445→	}
   446→
   447→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   448→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   449→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   450→		return nil
   451→	}
   452→
   453→	// Get git author
   454→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   455→	if err != nil {
   456→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   457→		return nil
   458→	}
   459→
   460→	// Get the active strategy
   461→	strat := GetStrategy()
   462→
   463→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   464→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   465→	if sessionID == "" {
   466→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   467→	}
   468→
   469→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   470→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   471→
   472→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   473→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   474→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   475→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   476→	if todoContent == "" {
   477→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   478→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   479→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   480→		if todoCount > 0 {
   481→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   482→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   483→		}
   484→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   485→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   486→	}
   487→
   488→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   489→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   490→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   491→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   492→	}
   493→
   494→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   495→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   496→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   497→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   498→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   499→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   500→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   501→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   502→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   503→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   504→		IsIncremental:       true,
   505→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   506→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   507→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   508→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   509→		AgentType:           agentType,
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   513→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   514→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   515→		return nil
   516→	}
   517→
   518→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   519→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   520→	return nil
   521→}
